message:
You know those moments when you think, "I’m so glad I prepared for this!"? 😊 That's the feeling we get when we take a little time to plan ahead. Whether it’s mapping out a family communication plan or gathering important documents, having a strategy in place can make all the difference when unexpected situations arise. 

This resource offers some great guidance on how to get started. Trust us, the peace of mind that comes from being prepared is priceless. 

What’s your favorite tip for staying ready?
